thread:
rachel_cs: Morning team — AsteriaEdge day0 dry-run prep. Need final confirmations for: static egress IPs (they require fixed source IPs), KMS BYOK import timeline, CloudTrail -> customer SIEM forwarding, and S3 permissions for audit dumps. Go/no-go by 14:00 PT.

devin_net: They sent the allowlist template. They want single IP per AZ (2 IPs) + a failover pair. Is 198.51.100.20-23 ok? Also they asked whether we can NAT from a private subnet instead of public NAT GW.

leo_cloudops: Recommend NAT GW per AZ for simplicity (we don't support NAT from private-only subnets without a proxy). Allocating 198.51.100.20/32 and 198.51.100.21/32 as primary, 198.51.100.22/32 and .23/32 as failover. Peering ranges: 10.50.0.0/16. Ports: 443 outbound; 9000 if they use internal s3-compatible collector.

anya_security: KMS BYOK: customer wants to import an external key material and use our CMK. We need their import token ETA and ownership proof. Also rotation rules: if key is imported, auto-rotation is disabled by AWS; we must capture that in runbook and advise manual rotation via new import. Recommend documented acceptance in SOW.

sam_se: Ops note: For audit logs we're shipping CloudTrail management + S3 data events to a dedicated S3 bucket (redwood-audit-asteriaedge). Customer wants direct push to their SIEM; propose we setup an S3 event notification -> lambda forwarder to their syslog endpoint. Need their collector FQDN and auth token.

rachel_cs: Legal flagged retention: AsteriaEdge requests 180-day retention (longer than our standard). Can we do 180?@anya_security

anya_security: Security is okay with 180d for this account with a signed addendum (mentions of export controls). Ask legal to include it in the SOW. I'll prepare the key-policy checklist.

opsbot: Ticket CS-8021 created: "AsteriaEdge private deploy - egress/KMS/audit runbook". Owner assigned: rachel_cs. Due 2026-04-05.

devin_net: Quick SG example for collector port: 
```
- Type: Custom TCP
  Port: 9000
  Destination: 203.0.113.45/32 (customer collector)
```

leo_cloudops: IAM trust policy for cross-account logs role (customer account will assume): 
```json
{
  \"Version\": \"2012-10-17\",
  \"Statement\":[{\n    \"Effect\":\"Allow\",\n    \"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/Asteria-LogForwarder\"},\n    \"Action\":\"sts:AssumeRole\",\n    \"Condition\":{\"StringEquals\":{\"sts:ExternalId\":\"asteria-edge-2026\"}}\n  }]\n}
```

anya_security: S3 bucket policy must prevent public ACLs and require TLS. Example (snippet): 
```json
{
  \"Statement\":[{\n    \"Effect\":\"Deny\",\n    \"Principal\":\"*\",\n    \"Action\":\"s3:PutObject\",\n    \"Resource\":\"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit-asteriaedge/*\",\n    \"Condition\":{\"Bool\":{\"aws:SecureTransport\":\"false\"}}\n  }]
}
```

sam_se: Can confirm we can attach the lambda forwarder code to the bucket notification — will need their collector token via secure ticket.

rachel_cs: Action items: 1) Devin confirm final IPs and SGs (due 2pm PT), 2) Asteria to provide collector FQDN + token (I will chase), 3) Anya prepare BYOK/key-policy checklist + legal addendum language for 180d, 4) Leo validate IAM role trust and provide role ARN.

devin_net: I'll post a diffs link to the VPC terraform in 10m.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run smoke at 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z. Results will be appended here.

rachel_cs: Noted — if any blocker appears after 13:30 PT, escalate to @ops-lead.

leo_cloudops: Posting NAT template: https://internal.redwood/templates/nat-ha 
Helm values excerpt for envoy egress: 
```yaml
egress:
  useStaticIP: true
  staticIPs: [\"198.51.100.20\", \"198.51.100.21\"]
```

anya_security: I'll attach the checklist and sample key policy to CS-8021.

rachel_cs: Thanks all — I'll update CS-8021 with the SOW note and ping legal. Leaving this open for confirmations.
